Create a JSON instance conforming to the following schema. Keep exactly the keys and permitted values, with no extra fields. Write a short explanation first and the JSON block at the end.

Schema:
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "title": "Scene",
  "description": "A Scene defines a set of properties and Elements to be shared among multile Pages. It also defines a background music to be played when one of those Pages is active.\nA Page is always associated with a Scene, either explicity with the \"scene\" property or implicitly with the default scene with name \"*\".\nThe Page inherits all the properties from the associated scene, including Elements. When the same property is specified both in the Page and the Scene, the value specified in the Page will be used. The only exception to this rule is Elements, which will be deep-merged (deep-inheritance). Elements with the id property will be merged, and other Elements will be appended (Elements defined in the Scene are always placed below Elements specified in the page).",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {},
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": []
}

schema.title: Scene
schema.description:
A Scene defines a set of properties and Elements to be shared among multile Pages. It also defines a background music to be played when one of those Pages is active.
A Page is always associated with a Scene, either explicity with the "scene" property or implicitly with the default scene with name "*".
The Page inherits all the properties from the associated scene, including Elements. When the same property is specified both in the Page and the Scene, the value specified in the Page will be used. The only exception to this rule is Elements, which will be deep-merged (deep-inheritance). Elements with the id property will be merged, and other Elements will be appended (Elements defined in the Scene are always placed below Elements specified in the page).

schema.title: Blockchain Certificates Receipt Schema, Version 1.2
schema.description: Provides evidence of the certificate on the blockchain, using the chainpoint v2 standard

@context.description: This should always be chainpoint v2 JSON LD context

type.description: type of hash. Currently the only supported hash type is SHA256, with chainpoint type ChainpointSHA256v2.

targetHash.description: hash of item being verified. Currently the only supported hash type is SHA256, and the targetHash format is validated accordingly.

merkleRoot.description: Merkle root value -- this is anchored to the blockchain. Currently the only supported hash type is SHA256, and merkleRoot format is validated accordingly.

proof.description: how to walk the Merkle tree from the target item to the Merkle root

left.description: value of left neighbor to combine into parent hash. Currently the only supported hash type is SHA256, and this value format is validated accordingly.

right.description: value of right neighbor to combine into parent hash. Currently the only supported hash type is SHA256, and this value format is validated accordingly.

anchors.description: how the proof is anchored to the blockchain

type.description: type of anchor, e.g. BTCOpReturn. Currently the only supported value is BTCOpReturn.

sourceId.description: How to lookup the proof on the blockchain. Currently this is expected to be the (value of the) Bitcoin transaction id, and this value format is validated accordingly

output:
Pentru schema primită am generat un obiect de tip „Blockchain Certificates Receipt Schema, Version 1.2”. Câmpurile de nivel superior sunt @context, type, targetHash, merkleRoot, proof și anchors, iar valorile se încadrează în restricțiile declarate.

- `@context` — șir de caractere, obligatoriu.
- `type` — șir de caractere, obligatoriu.
- `targetHash` — șir de caractere, obligatoriu.
- `merkleRoot` — șir de caractere, obligatoriu.
- `proof` — listă de obiecte, obligatoriu.
- `anchors` — listă de obiecte, obligatoriu.

În continuare dau obiectul JSON propriu-zis:

{"@context": "https://w3id.org/chainpoint/v2", "type": "ChainpointSHA256v2", "targetHash": "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567", "merkleRoot": "fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210", "proof": [{"left": "1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890", "right": "fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210fedcba98"}, {"left": "fedcba9876543210", "right": "1234567890abcdef"}], "anchors": [{"type": "BTCOpReturn", "sourceId": "1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890"}]}

schema.title: JSON schema for Bower configuration files

description.description: Help users identify and search for your package with a brief description.

main.description: The primary acting files necessary to use your package.

license.description: SPDX license identifier or path/url to a license.

ignore.description: A list of files for Bower to ignore when installing your package.

keywords.description: Used for search by keyword. Helps make your package easier to discover without people needing to know its name.

authors.description: A list of people that authored the contents of the package.

homepage.description: URL to learn more about the package. Falls back to GitHub project if not specified and it's a GitHub endpoint.

repository.description: The repository in which the source code can be found.

dependencies.description: Dependencies are specified with a simple hash of package name to a semver compatible identifier or URL.

devDependencies.description: Dependencies that are only needed for development of the package, e.g., test framework or building documentation.

resolutions.description: Dependency versions to automatically resolve with if conflicts occur between packages.

private.description: If you set it to  true  it will refuse to publish it. This is a way to prevent accidental publication of private repositories.

exportsOverride.description: Used by grunt-bower-task to specify custom install locations.

moduleType.description: The types of modules this package exposes

^_.description: Any property starting with _ is valid.

output:

Câmpurile de nivel superior sunt name, description, version, main, license, ignore, keywords, authors, homepage, repository, dependencies, devDependencies, resolutions, private, exportsOverride și moduleType, iar valorile se încadrează în restricțiile declarate.

- `name` — șir de caractere, obligatoriu.
- `description` — șir de caractere.
- `version` — șir de caractere.
- `main` — listă.
- `license` — listă de șiruri de caractere.
- `ignore` — listă de șiruri de caractere.
- `keywords` — listă de șiruri de caractere.
- `authors` — listă.
- `homepage` — șir de caractere.
- `repository` — obiect.
- `dependencies` — obiect.
- `devDependencies` — obiect.
- `resolutions` — obiect.
- `private` — valoare booleană.
- `exportsOverride` — obiect.
- restul de 1 câmpuri urmează la fel schema.

În continuare dau obiectul JSON propriu-zis:

{"name": "my-package", "description": "Pachetul meu de test", "version": "1.0.0", "main": "index.js", "license": "MIT", "ignore": ["README.md", "LICENSE"], "keywords": ["test", "package"], "authors": ["Ion Popescu"], "homepage": "https://example.com/my-package", "repository": {"type": "git", "url": "https://github.com/ionpopescu/my-package.git"}, "dependencies": {"jquery": "^3.6.0"}, "devDependencies": {"grunt": "^1.0.1"}, "resolutions": {"jquery": "3.6.0"}, "private": false, "exportsOverride": {"index.js": "dist/index.js"}, "moduleType": ["amd", "es6"]}
